zh-CN.title: 个性化设置与应用名称统一
items: 主题和广场布局改用模态框，统一手机语音输入等选项的样式。
外部应用名称统一采用“中文 · English”。

en.title: Consistent preferences and app names
items: Theme and Square layout settings now open in dialogs, with consistent option styling including mobile voice input.
External app names consistently use Chinese · English.
